capabilities.name: Discovery record validation and expiry
capabilities.description: Validates required record fields, endpoint URI, timestamps and bounded expiry; expired records are never returned.
limitations: The record contract is local and not yet bound to the canonical Resource Manifest or Capability Registry schemas.

capabilities.name: Trust-filtered in-memory discovery index
capabilities.description: Indexes records and requires injected signature-verification and issuer-trust callbacks before returning candidates.
limitations: Callbacks are integration seams, not cryptographic or production identity implementations.

capabilities.name: Distributed discovery and federation
capabilities.description: Future authenticated publication, replication, gossip and multi-domain discovery.
limitations: No network API, gossip protocol, federation or distributed consistency is implemented.

explicit_non_capabilities: Cryptographic signature creation or verification implementation
Capability certification or proof of advertised behavior
Distributed storage, gossip, federation or Sybil resistance
